evidence: Carries the Utils/log/libs label and adds AssertUnreachable to util/check.h.
rationale: Adds an AssertUnreachable macro to util/check.h that calls the noreturn assertion_fail helper, replacing existing assert(false) and Assert(false) calls throughout the codebase. This resolves GCC return-type warnings caused by hiding [[noreturn]] behind Assert(false), avoids NDEBUG ambiguities, and prevents potential undefined behavior hazards from future std::unreachable adoption.
